trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 are done, so treat it as a finish line rather than a task: there is nothing to do for this one directly. Work through the story, the 100% checklist and the side strands in the order this guide's roadmap sets out, and the platinum pops on the last trophy you earn, whatever that turns out to be.
sources: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open Progress, then Stats, then the 100% Completion checklist once the story is done, and work down its numbers instead of hunting everything: 100 optional tasks, all 39 gang operations, all 22 bank jobs, all 7 payday loan jobs, 8 of 8 bank vaults, $250,000 of marked bills fenced, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 of 125 cocaine flamingos, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, 100 of 255 animals studied, 30 of 40 races won, all 42 shooting-range golds, 42 of 42 drone time trials, 300 of 397 stunts and 70 of 80 challenges. The checklist only asks for part of most activities, so stop each one the moment its number is met and move on.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
GameMapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count, so pick the easy kinds and repeat them: jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all add to the same tally, and the counter keeps running in free roam. Work stunts into ordinary driving between missions rather than grinding them in one sitting, and check the tally in Progress so you know when you are close.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
GameMapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. None of them needs a win or a score, so one quick try of each is enough, and doing them early means they are already done when the roadmap reaches the activity cleanup.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
GameMapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting-range challenges across the 12 ranges. Each range has its own set of challenges, so visit every range and clear its list; the medal thresholds are shown before each challenge starts, so pick the weapon and stance the challenge favours. This is also a 100% checklist item, so it has to be finished for A Long Road anyway.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own race, and winning once per location is enough — you do not need to win every race the location offers. The 42 drone time trials are a separate 100% requirement, so learning the drone handling here pays off twice.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The race types are spread across Leonida, so enter a spread of events rather than repeating one favourite; the 100% checklist wants 30 of 40 races won, so the 20 for this trophy are on the way to that bigger number.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head contests, so bring your best rod and bait for the species the challenge names, and watch Cal's tally as you fish — the win comes from out-catching him, not from the biggest single fish.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Pick the shortest game in the arcade and play it through to its end screen; there is no score requirement, so finishing is all that counts.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight qualifying stranger mission strands across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as question marks and side characters around the map; each strand is a short chain, so follow each one to its end rather than starting many and finishing none. The five character finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are separate trophies of their own.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: The first meditation (balcony with Lucia after Down to Earth, Chapter 1) is the only one reported as potentially missable — do it before Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The one to protect is the first: after the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning, follow her to the balcony when she mentions meditating, and complete that meditation before Chapter 1 ends — it is the only one currently reported as missable. The other 17 spots stay open in free roam, and 15 of 18 already satisfy the 100% checklist, so finish the last three for the trophy itself.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three full collectible card sets; there are 18 sets in the game. Cards turn up across Leonida, so pick three sets and chase their cards specifically rather than collecting at random, and use the in-game collection screen to see which cards of a set you still lack. The 100% checklist wants 15 of 18 sets, so this trophy is an early step on a longer hunt.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations: landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count. Scan anything unfamiliar as you travel — vehicles, sights, street art — and the tally climbs without any dedicated grinding. One hundred scans also satisfy the 100% checklist.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and more, and the easiest 50 are enough, so skip the ones that ask for rare feats and clear the straightforward ones first. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so keep going past 50 if you are chasing A Long Road.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a four-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Get the heat up to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear; the trophy pops when the wanted level drops to nothing, not while you are still hiding.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Hit three shops in a row in one run while your partner is with you, keeping the wanted level alive between them — if the stars clear, the chain breaks and you start again. Pick three shops close together and plan the route before the first robbery.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A WAiNK scan of a vehicle you have not seen before counts as a discovery, so scan every new car, bike, boat and aircraft you pass. The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base models, so the scanning habit you build here carries straight into A Long Road.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
GameMapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with at least five enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before the meter runs out; open areas with grouped enemies work better than narrow corridors.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses raising the alert, and get out with the goods before anyone notices. If a guard spots you, leave and try again rather than fighting through it.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape. Bank vaults open up properly once the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… unlocks them in Chapter 4, so do not force it earlier. Plan the escape route before the robbery starts — the trophy needs the getaway as well as the vault.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, take it down, grab the cash and get clear of the wanted level. Trucks run set routes around Leonida, so watch for one on a quiet stretch rather than in the middle of Vice City traffic.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida and uncover the complete map. Drive, fly and sail into every corner of the state until no fog remains on the map; the far edges and islands are the parts people miss, so check the map for any grey patches.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Each gang runs its own illegal operations around Leonida, so work through the gangs one at a time and keep a note of which ones you have hit.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies, and fencing them through contacts turns them into clean cash; the tally is cumulative, so keep fencing as you go and it adds up. The same $250,000 also satisfies the 100% checklist.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy weapons, clothes, food and anything else the shops sell; the total is cumulative across every shop, so ordinary spending through the story already covers much of it, and a late shopping spree finishes the rest.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all eight purchasable garage properties. Garages go on sale as the story opens up Leonida; buy each one when it appears rather than saving for later, since some only unlock in later chapters.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, pick a vehicle you own or have found, and register it; repeat until the count reaches ten. Any ten vehicles count, so register the ones you already drive.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. This is the first mission of the game and unlocks automatically as you play through it — there is nothing extra to do.
sources: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Play through the first chapter's missions; the trophy pops when the chapter ends. Keep a manual save at the chapter's start in case you want a backup — and do the balcony meditation with Lucia before the chapter closes, or the Positive Mental Attitude trophy is at risk.
sources: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Finish the second chapter's missions; the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter so you can go back if you want a cleaner run at anything you skipped.
sources: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Finish the third chapter's missions; the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. New side strands open up in this chapter, including Andy's questline for Lucia, so take a look at them before moving on.
sources: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Finish the fourth chapter's missions; the trophy unlocks when the chapter ends. The bank vaults open up in this chapter through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, so keep an eye out for it.
sources: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 5 — the final story mission. Finish the last mission and watch the credits; the gold pops with the story's end. After the story, free roam stays open, so everything you have not finished yet is still there to chase.
sources: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Play through the mission as the story presents it; no special preparation is needed.
sources: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Play through the heist as the story presents it; it is a story mission, so it unlocks in order.
sources: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Play through the mission as the story presents it.
sources: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

sources: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand asks for specific animals; track the unique one he names and take it down. Finishing all 15 of Bret's Target Deck objectives is also a 100% checklist item.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport. Get onto the tarmac as a plane is leaving, board it and take off; airport security will be on you, so be ready to fly straight out.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Rhinos are guarded at military sites, so plan the approach, grab one and put its cannon to work; the trophy needs the tank used in a fight, not just driven.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by the community, so head to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view and order a cocktail; if it does not pop, try different spots along the beachfront. Check current guides before chasing this one — the method is unconfirmed.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact method is still unconfirmed, so take a car through a showroom's frontage and drive out through the wreckage; try different showrooms if the first attempt does not trigger it. Check current guides before chasing this one — the method is unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley: steal the three key valuables there and escape. Get in, take the three items, and get out before security locks the place down; the escape matters as much as the theft.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out the Strength stat for Jason and Lucia at the same time. Train both characters — gym work, melee and heavy lifting raise Strength — and keep both at maximum together; the trophy checks the pair, not one of them.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Almost anything criminal counts — robberies, thefts, getaways — so the tally climbs naturally through ordinary play; check the profile to see the count and mop up the remainder with quick crimes late in the game.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — the unlock method for this hidden trophy is still unconfirmed by the community. Keep an eye on guide updates; do not waste hours guessing at triggers that have not been verified.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The unlock method for this hidden trophy is still unconfirmed. It is one of five hidden trophies whose triggers the community is still working out — check current guides before chasing it.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by
